evals.prompt: Fetch JIRA issues for the CCDI Hub project
evals.expected_output: Returns a structured dict with project_name, display_name, total count, and a list of issues each having issue_type, issue_key, summary, status, priority, created, updated, duedate fields
expectations: Output contains a 'project_name' field equal to 'CCDI Hub'
Output contains a 'display_name' field equal to 'CCDI Portal (aka CCDI Hub)'
Each issue has fields: issue_type, issue_key, summary, status
Script handles JIRA_TOKEN/JIRA_URL env vars correctly

evals.prompt: Get all tickets from the CCDI Federation project so I can use them in my report
evals.expected_output: Fetches FEDERATION project issues and returns structured data; prints a formatted table to console and saves a JSON file
expectations: Issues list is present (may be empty if project has no matching tickets)
A JSON file is saved to the working directory

evals.prompt: Pull JIRA issues for the Index of NCI Studies project — I only want issues updated in the last 30 days
evals.expected_output: Fetches INS project issues with a JQL filter for updated >= -30d; returns structured data
expectations: Output contains 'project_name' equal to 'Index of NCI Studies'
JQL includes an updated date filter or uses the JIRA_JQL env var
Script does not crash on missing duedate fields
